checklist.notes: the utterance includes content words and two-syllable twenty; the practice reference is tied to the lesson pronunciation scope.
An exact repeatable utterance and audio-only assessment boundary permit safe practice, with NOT_ASSESSED required without audio.
The protocol reuses a source-lesson utterance and declared scope rather than introducing an unrelated target.
The utterance and audio requirement are clear, although the internal feature label helps the tutor more than the learner.
One question at a time and bounded output or feedback keep the interaction manageable for the declared tier.
Audio is required for any score or phonetic judgment, and text-only input cannot become pronunciation evidence.
The short, structured self-study interaction is accessible to Vietnamese learners and avoids unsupported population-wide or accent claims.

findings.description: The learner-visible opening gives an utterance but no plain-language cue naming the sound, stress, syllable, weak form, or link to attend to.
findings.recommendation: Add one short learner-facing feature cue derived from the source lesson while keeping assessment audio-only.

limitations: Static protocol wording only was reviewed. No live provider behavior, audio realization, learner response or outcome, provider authentication, human review, or release approval was observed or claimed.
